title: Commit Step Contract
description: Schema for commit_step.json -- the single source of the shared commit step's one-answer contract: answer_version, the answer keys with their empty values, the reason_code enumeration partitioned into disjoint families, and the two retry ceilings. The step validates the same structure by hand (stdlib only) at start; this schema is the published form of that check.

answer_version.description: Version of the answer contract; changes with any breaking edit of keys or codes.

answer_keys.description: Every key of the answer, mapped to its empty value (null or an empty list).

reason_codes.description: Disjoint families: refused answers carry policy or step codes, hook_failed carries check codes, nothing_to_commit carries nothing codes.

max_automated_fix_retries.description: Re-runs allowed after a fixing check rewrites a named file.

max_transient_retries.description: Fresh calls a caller may make on a step_ code.

input_wait_limit_seconds.description: Supervised calls only: seconds a check may stay silent (waiting for input) before it is ended and the call answers hook_failed / check_awaited_input.
